instance: CrashLoopBackOff when Chainguard Nginx with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true attempts to create /var/lib/nginx/tmp/client_body and /run/nginx.pid — needs emptyDir volumes for /var/cache/nginx, /var/lib/nginx/tmp, /run, and /tmp to be writable.
check: Parse pod logs for 'Read-only file system' errors; validate writable paths have emptyDir mounts in pod spec.

instance: Traefik IngressRoute CRD validation fails with 'Unsupported value: rule' when kind field uses lowercase 'rule' instead of 'Rule'.
check: Validate IngressRoute spec kind field case during template validation or linting.

instance: cloudflared pod routes to dashboard-configured origin (https://resume.petersimmons.com) instead of local config.yaml (http://192.168.0.180) because Cloudflare remote config takes precedence, overriding local ingress rules.
check: Verify cloudflared logs show correct originService matching LB IP; probe tunnel with expected origin.

instance: Pod fails with 'exec: /bin/sh: stat /bin/sh: no such file or directory' when cloudflare/cloudflared:latest (distroless) receives command: ['/bin/sh', '-c', ...] wrapper instead of args.
check: Detect distroless images in pod specs; warn against shell-based command wrappers or reject them.

instance: Cloudflare --token flag cannot be used with --config; requires decoding base64 token to JSON (a/t/s fields) and converting to credentials file format (AccountTag/TunnelID/TunnelSecret).
check: Validate credentials file format before mounting to pod; run tunnel connectivity test.

instance: Pod logs show 'control stream encountered a failure while serving' with indefinite retries when cloudflared credential files reference tunnels that were deleted or expired in Cloudflare.
check: Run cloudflared tunnel list before reusing credentials; verify tunnel status via Cloudflare dashboard API.

instance: Certificate stuck in 'Issuing' state for 30 days with Ready=False when ingress annotation references non-existent ClusterIssuer 'letsencrypt-production' (actual issuer named 'letsencrypt-prod'); cert-manager produces no error logs.
check: Query certificate status directly; flag certificates with Ready=False >24h with no events; validate ClusterIssuer existence before ingress creation.

instance: Four Failed/Completed pods accumulated over 38 hours with no garbage collection; job pods (linkerd-heartbeat, trivy scans) remain in Failed state consuming etcd memory and creating monitoring noise.
check: Query pods with field-selector=status.phase=Failed; alert if count >3 or age >48h.

instance: 278 empty (0/0/0) ReplicaSets accumulated across cluster due to default revisionHistoryLimit=10 with high-frequency deployments; clearwatch had 10-12 dead RSes per service, causing slow kubectl operations and etcd memory pressure.
check: Query kubectl get replicasets and count empty ones (all replica counts zero); recommend revisionHistoryLimit: 3.

instance: Three deployments (uss-constitution 369 restarts, uss-enterprise 547 restarts, uss-tang 369 restarts) stuck in rolling update state for days; new versions failed to start, creating pod pairs from different ReplicaSets with stable old pods retained while new pods cycled through CrashLoopBackOff.
check: Detect two pods from different ReplicaSets for same deployment; check restart counts; use progressDeadlineSeconds to auto-fail stuck rollouts.

instance: Three deployments (job-search fastapi, gmail-tracker, proxmox-monitor) held node resource reservations for 6 days in ImagePullBackOff state; container images were never built+pushed to registry or had been deleted.
check: Query ImagePullBackOff pods; validate image exists in registry before kubectl apply; alert if ImagePullBackOff >1 hour.

instance: searxng deployment running fixed 20 replicas with no HPA; at idle with 0% CPU and 24% memory, wasting 18 unnecessary pods.
check: Query deployments without HPA; flag stateless multi-replica deployments as candidates for autoscaling policies.
